Minutes Draft
                      Girdwood Trails Committee Regular Meeting
                               Tuesday, Oct 6, 2026 7:00PM
Girdwood Trails Committee meetings are taking place on Teams with in-person attendance at the Girdwood Community
Room, 250 Egloff Rd.


GTC Voting members are defined as any person eighteen (18) years of age or older who has attended one or more Trails Committee
meetings in the last 12 months, and is:
a)      a current resident and/or property owner, business owner or designated representative of a non-profit association; and
b)     who has resided in, owned property in, owned a business located in, or operated as a non-profit association for the preceding
ninety (90) days or longer in Girdwood Valley.
Attendance is verified through a sign-in sheet available at each meeting, or equivalent process.

The Girdwood Trails Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7PM Brian Burnett, co-chair
Approval of Oct 6 2026 meeting agenda *        C Brodin/K Sandberg             Assent
Approval of Sept 1 2026 meeting minutes        B Sullivan/M Esslinger            Assent

*During the meeting, New Business item #10 is moved to Old Business due to time constraints. Motion by B Sullivan/2nd M Esslinger.
Motion carries by assent.

Announcements & Presentations:
GTC November 3 meeting will be held via teams only as the community room will be in use for election.


Introductions: No new or unannounced attendees online noted

Public Comment (3 minutes each):
Burnett/Sullivan: GNSC Girdwood Trails Marathon completed over the weekend with great participation in the races and help from
numerous volunteers. Funds raised are used for grooming efforts and a donation is made to Girdwood Trails. Future races will be run in
the clockwise direction only, in order to facilitate safer crossing of Alyeska Highway. GTC will write thank you for donation once
donation is received.

Old Business:

     1.  GTC Recommendation for GBOS Resolution of Support for RTP Grant application for crew and materials to work on Beaver
       Pond Trail
Group reviews the Beaver Pond Trail designation in the Trails Management Plan and the list of priority projects. Priority project list
needs to be updated following the active summer trail work season, this item is next on the priority list as projects before it have been
initiated/completed or are not suitable for RTP grant. Total amount of grant funding to be requested is not yet known as quotes are
being requested. Cap for RTP grant application for multi-use project is $300,000; match is 10%.

Motion:
GTC moves to recommend that the GBOS write a Resolution of Support for RTP grant application to work on the Beaver Pond Trail.
Motion by K Sandberg/2nd W Brennan
Motion carries by assent

     2.  Girdwood Iditarod National Historic Trail
Middle Iditarod Reroute in Holtan Hills Phase 1: Re-route generally determined. HLB should add this to their 2027 work plan as work on
this is within the responsibility of HLB and developer partnership.

Iditarod Historic Trail Alliance (IHTA) funded easements on GwINHT: Survey complete, currently working on documentation and
completing easement process.





                   Girdwood Trails Committee Agendas and minutes are available on line: www.muni.org/gtc

3.  Update on Winner Creek Trail Bridge at Glacier Creek (Kyle)
No progress in the last month. Contract was issued in spring 2026. Contractor and purchasing are working through issues related to
costs and geopolitical impact on the project.

     4.  Consider Community Trails Info message for upcoming month to be shared on social media
Slippery roots/soft trails. Report issues to Parks and Rec.

     5.  Girdwood Trails Management Plan Revision and Review
Status of Appendix 1 (maps): Complete, need to be incorporated into document
Appendix 2 (list and descriptions of trails): not started yet
Appendix 8 (land management agreements and easements): draft started

At this meeting it was noted that the priority list needs to be updated, Appendix 5 will be added to the list in future agenda. This was
most recently reviewed and approved in Feb 2026 and is probably an annual task.

     6.  Girdwood Comprehensive Plan RE Parcel 6-011 and Upper Valley Trails:
No update, this item will move to Ongoing Trails Issues on future agendas.

     7.  Summer trails projects wrap up
Lower Virgin Creek trail: Assessment completed this week, determining 3 main projects for volunteer/staff work next summer:
Improve trail to create single, sustainable access to climb to the ridge from gully where the trail starts
Create water crossings to get over muddy holes
Overall the trail is pretty dry and well-established.

Middle INHT: Alaska Trails Crew finished their work hired by the GVSA and transitioned to work on the part of the trail that is USFS
responsibility at the end of the summer. Project is to align the 2nd Crow Creek Road crossings to be directly across from each other
and have a more gradual entry than the existing rock steps. Trail Crew has completed their hitch, USFS crew now finishing the project.

Girdwood Parks and Rec projects are mostly complete for the season. Trail signs for Winner Creek Extension trail will be posted in the
coming days. Re-build of the bridge on the Extension Trail will go on the project list for 2027.

     8.  GTC Recommendations for entry area to the Holtan Hills neighborhood
GTC leans toward parking/trailhead access but has not voted on this. No further communication from CY Investments, developer of
Holtan Hills and there is lack of clarity on maintenance, etc. Item will be moved to Ongoing Trails Issues on future agendas.

     9.  GNSC request for GTC Recommendation for GBOS Resolution of support for RTP grant (Essex)
Item moved from New Business to old based on time constraints.
Group discusses that this request was made and passed GTC in 2024, prior resolution is available for review in the meeting packet.

Motion:
GTC moves to recommend that GBOS write a Resolution of Support for the Girdwood Nordic Ski Club’s RTP grant application.
Motion by K Sandberg, 2nd C Brodin
Motion carries by Assent

New Business: None

Other:
    10. Ongoing Trails Issues for update:
             •   Status of Trails grants: See meeting packet
             •   Other Trails Issues
Motorized Use: Soren Wuerth asks about GTC position on e-bikes and motorized bikes on trails.
GTC must follow municipal code on MOA trails. Municipal code essentially states that bikes without pedals are motorized and are not
allowed on trails. Other equipment, such as one-wheels, also do not have pedals and are not technically allowed on trails.
Other land managers, such as USFS and DOT, have rules that they could enforce on their land.

Kirchner Family contributions to Girdwood Trails. Brian Burnett suggests that GTC should be in touch with Kirchner family and see if
there is a trail or area that could be named in their honor. Possibly the pallet trail could be renamed.

    11. Monthly LUC/GBOS Meeting Representatives:
    12. Written Reports should be submitted to include in meeting packet

Adjourn 8:05PM
